summary: The US team has no title partner. The partner block on its website (ussailgpteam.com, opened 2026-09-30) lists Tommy Hilfiger (PVH), Crypto.com | OG, Luxury Group Marriott International, AG1, Amazon, CîROC (Diageo), Apex, Leyton, Bermuda, Beatbot, Barton & Gray, Zhik and Nomadix, each documented here by a team or company announcement. Not marked complete: the same block lists three more names, Hudson River Community Sailing, Protect Where We Play and Spectrum Sailing, which are community programmes and aren't recorded as sponsors.
